text:
Sam Lee: Heads-up 1 OrionX asked for a compact deliverable set for a joint perf-vs-watt validation next week. They want a single page pass/fail matrix for marketplace listing plus the raw curves. Can we scope?

Maya Patel: I can run the curves and own the CSV schema. Proposing 4 axes: model, seq_len, concurrency, kernel_build. Also include idle_baseline_w and gpu_board_temp_c.

Lars Berg: I11 can take kernel QA and the rollback hooks. Note: OrionX images are sealed; we can only provide an initrd livepatch. Need confirmation from their infra team. If livepatch not allowed, we'll provide a dockerized user-space shim.

bench-bot: OrionX-wattcurve-run scheduled: start=2026-04-14T08:00Z duration=36h runners=6 owner=@Sam Lee

Sam Lee: Thanks. Maya 1 can you post the CSV example? Keep minimal but include calibration fields.

Maya Patel: Draft CSV below. Comments welcome.

```csv
run_id,model,seq_len,concurrency,kernel_tag,idle_baseline_w,avg_power_w,peak_power_w,throughput_tok_s,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,gpu_temp_c,notes
orx-20260414-01,redwood-7b,1024,2,orx-5.14-livepatch,82.1,398.6,442.0,1450.2,9.8,18.7,71.2,first-pass
```

Lars Berg: Checklist (short): 1) verify livepatch signature + SHA; 2) run kernel smoke w/ stress-ng; 3) pin IRQs and set rt_affinity; 4) confirm PCIe ASPM off; 5) capture per-socket ENERGY_COUNTER stats. Will add commands to runbook.

Sam Lee: Acceptance criteria suggestion: marketplace pass if (a) perf/W improves >=5% vs baseline and (b) no functional regressions and (c) thermal steady-state < 80C for full 30-minute run. Thoughts?

Maya Patel: LGTM. Add one more: repeatability: stddev of throughput across 3 runs <2.5%.

Lars Berg: Operational note: if livepatch triggers a kernel oops, we need a kill-switch that reboots into known-good image and uploads dmesg + kdump. I'll prepare a rollback script.

Sam Lee: Good. Also decide on telemetry transport: S3 upload from bench hosts + signing, or direct secure SCP to OrionX dev bucket. Prefer S3 presigned URLs for audit trail.

Maya Patel: I'll bake presigned upload into CI step. Will also include a small json metadata file with git_rev, bench_machine_id, and calibration_offset_w.

bench-bot: Reminder: OrionX preflight checklist due in 9h.

Sam Lee: Quick risk bullets (drop 1 each):

Maya Patel: Risk: sensor drift across racks -> mitigation: run per-machine zero-current calibration and store offset.

Lars Berg: Risk: livepatch not permitted -> mitigation: deliver user-space shim + verified tests; run extra canaries.

Sam Lee: Risk: partner timeline slips -> mitigation: buffer 48h and offer anonymized results for marketplace copy.

Maya Patel: I'll post runbook + scraping config by EOD and tag OrionX contacts.

Lars Berg: I'll draft the rollback + kdump upload script and publish to the run artifacts.

Sam Lee: Thanks all. I'll send kickoff note + invite their infra lead for Thu 9am PT. Keep comments here for traceability. :white_check_mark:
